weather.name: Sandstorm

params.note: 沙暴期间双方地面系技能能耗减半；能耗修正尚未接入伤害/能耗管线【待校准】。

weather.rawText: During a sandstorm, both sides' Earth-type skills have their energy cost halved.

weather.name: Blizzard

params.note: 暴雪期间双方每回合末获得 2 层冻结（冰系免疫）；需在结算钩子实现【待校准】。

weather.rawText: During a blizzard, both sides gain 2 stacks of Freeze at the end of each turn. (Ice-type Jinies are immune to this effect.)
